$comment: The navigation of source.riffpress.com, in one place: site-nav.js stamps it into every page written by hand and site-shell.js into every generated one. Each entry of sections is one link in the header, in this order, but the one marked root: that is the host's home, which Source beside the wordmark leads to, titled with the host's name alone. href is the page's path on the site as written, before developers-site.js moves the reference from developers/ to the host's root. host names the host, for the title. The root's children marked door are the doors: the home lists them, each has a page listing its own pages with their summary, and a page in a door has the door's pages alone in its sidebar, with a switcher to the other doors at the top. A child with children of its own, inside a door, is a group in the sidebar. ordered gives a door's or a group's pages a previous and next link. bar: false keeps a page out of the sidebar while it still belongs where it sits, as a hook under PHP. footer lists the footer's few links, in one line, by key, or as label and href for a page off the site.
